title: Agent / MCP Security Scanner input
description: Paste Claude Desktop, Cursor, or other MCP client config (JSON/JSONC/TOML/YAML). Offline read-only scan for tool poisoning, leaked secrets, unsafe commands, and YOLO/auto-approve posture. Never launches MCP servers or calls remote endpoints with your config.

configText.title: Config content
configText.description: Paste one config body (mcp.json, claude_desktop_config.json, Cursor MCP servers JSON, tools/list export, Codex TOML). Default prefill is a deliberately vulnerable Claude-style sample (root filesystem MCP, fake GitHub token, curl|bash install) so Try-it shows findings immediately. Set Config filename so the parser picks the right format.

configFileName.title: Config filename
configFileName.description: Logical filename for Config content. Extension selects the parser (.json / .jsonc / .toml / .yaml). Examples: mcp.json, claude_desktop_config.json, cursor-mcp.json.

configFiles.title: Additional configs
configFiles.description: Optional list of extra configs, each with name + content. Use when scanning several files in one run.

outputFormat.title: Report format
outputFormat.description: Format of the report file written to the key-value store (key: REPORT).

failOn.title: Fail on severity
failOn.description: If any finding is at or above this severity, the Actor run ends FAILED (CI gate). Keep none for Store Try-it and demo configs that intentionally contain findings.

minSeverity.title: Minimum severity to report
minSeverity.description: Hide findings below this severity from the dataset and report.

rules.title: Only these rules
rules.description: Optional comma-separated rule ids (e.g. ASC010,ASC022). Empty = all rules.

ignore.title: Ignore rules
ignore.description: Optional comma-separated rule ids to skip.
